title: Correct induced EMF
description: Essential: The final answer for the induced electromotive force must be correctly derived as E = k l² / 2.

title: Correct motion time
description: Essential: The final answer for the time t₀ when motion begins must be correctly derived as t₀ = 2 m g R / (k² l³).

title: Application of Faraday's Law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Faraday's law, relating the EMF to the rate of change of magnetic flux through the effective area (half the loop).

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: The solution must set up the condition for motion by equating the upward magnetic force to the downward gravitational force (mg = F_A).

title: Magnetic force derivation
description: Important: The solution must correctly derive the Ampere force on the loop using the induced current (I = E/R) and the relevant magnetic field and length.

title: Effective area consideration
description: Optional: The solution explicitly notes that only half the loop area is within the field, so the effective flux area is l²/2.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution uses an incorrect sign for the induced EMF or misidentifies the direction of the force, affecting the motion condition.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answers are presented with inconsistent or missing units, or if dimensional analysis is flawed.
